name: The Hundred
description: A classic Pilates warm-up. Lie on your back with legs in tabletop and arms pumping by your sides while holding a slight curl. Builds core heat and stability.

name: Single Leg Circles
description: Lie on your back and draw large circles with one leg while keeping the pelvis stable. Mobilises the hip joint and strengthens the surrounding muscles.

name: Rolling Like a Ball
description: Sit in a tight ball shape and roll gently back and forth along your spine. Massages the spine and challenges abdominal control.

name: Single Leg Stretch
description: A supine core exercise alternating legs while keeping the opposite leg extended. Coordinates breathing with limb movement.

name: Double Leg Stretch
description: Lie on your back and reach arms and legs away from centre on the inhale then hug them back in. Challenges core stability under load.

name: Spine Stretch Forward
description: Sit tall and reach forward between your legs as if curving over a ball. Lengthens the spine and hamstrings.

name: Open Leg Rocker
description: Balance on your tailbone holding your ankles or calves and rock back and forth. Requires balance and abdominal control.

name: Corkscrew
description: Lie on your back and circle both legs together while keeping the pelvis stable. Advances Single Leg Circles.

name: Swan
description: Lie face-down and press up into a gentle back extension. Strengthens the posterior chain and counteracts forward-flexion.

name: Swan Dive
description: Progress from Swan by rocking forward and back on the belly. Requires significant back strength and coordination.

name: Single Leg Kick
description: Lie face-down with upper body lifted and kick each heel toward the glutes alternately. Works the hamstrings and glutes.

name: Double Leg Kick
description: Lie face-down and kick both heels to the glutes twice then extend the arms back as the chest lifts. Combines back extension with hamstring work.

name: Neck Pull
description: A demanding sit-up with hands behind the head. Tests full spinal articulation and abdominal strength.

name: Side Kick
description: Lie on your side and swing the top leg forward and back in a controlled arc. Works hip flexors and glutes.

name: Teaser
description: The signature Pilates V-sit: roll up to balance on your tailbone with legs and torso at 45 degrees. Demands full-body integration.

name: Seal
description: Similar to Rolling Like a Ball but clap your ankles three times at each end of the roll. A playful finish to a session.

name: Mermaid
description: Sit in a Z-sit or cross-legged and reach one arm overhead while side-bending. Opens the lateral body and obliques.

name: Spine Twist
description: Sit tall and rotate the torso left and right. Improves thoracic rotation and lengthens the obliques.

name: Leg Pull Front
description: Start in a plank and kick each leg up alternately. Challenges shoulder stability and hip extension.

name: Leg Pull Back
description: Sit in a reverse plank and kick each leg up. Works posterior chain and shoulder extension.

name: Push Up
description: Classic push-up modified for Pilates: roll down from standing and walk out to plank then perform push-ups before rolling back up.

name: Kneeling Side Kicks
description: Kneel upright and kick the top leg forward and back while keeping the torso stable. A side kick variation with more trunk challenge.

name: Hip Circles
description: Support yourself on your hands and knees and draw large circles with your hips. Mobilises the hip joints in all planes.

name: Boomerang
description: Advanced combination of Teaser and Rolling Like a Ball into a swan stretch. Requires excellent control and flexibility.

name: Control Balance
description: An advanced inversion where you balance on your shoulders and reach alternate legs toward the ceiling.

name: Stomach Massage
description: A reformer-inspired movement done on the mat. Rounds the spine and pumps the legs to massage the abdominals.

name: Footwork
description: Sit tall and flex and point the feet in various positions. Warms up the lower legs and ankles — great for beginners.

name: Chest Expansion
description: Kneel tall and sweep both arms back while gazing over each shoulder. Opens the chest and practises Pilates breathing.

name: Thigh Stretch
description: From a kneeling position hinge the body back as one unit while keeping the hips open. Lengthens the quads and hip flexors.

name: Side Bend
description: Sit on one hip and press up into a full side plank then arc the top arm overhead. Strengthens the obliques and shoulder girdle.
